title: “Tweet” and the bird logo apparently enter the public domain
summary: This legal analysis by Eric Goldman explains how the word 'tweet' and Twitter's iconic bird logo have apparently entered the public domain after copyright protection expired, while X Corp continues to maintain trademark protection over the 'Twitter' brand name for now.
problem_solved: Clarifies the complex intellectual property rights situation surrounding Twitter's brand assets after the X Corp acquisition and rebranding.
why_valuable: Provides important legal clarity for businesses and individuals who may now use 'tweet' and the bird logo without copyright concerns, while understanding the still-active trademark restrictions.
